institution_responsible_for_the_project.description: The data controller is the institution that determines why (purpose) and how (methods) personal data will be processed (legally responsible).

project_leader.description: The project leader must be a supervisor, scientific staff member or a research fellow, formally affiliated with the data controller.

joint_data_controller_question.question: Do multiple institutions share responsibility (joint data controllers)?
joint_data_controller_question.description: The responsibility is shared if two or more institutions jointly determine why and how personal data will be processed.
